premise_review: Every18321B original and complete organized payload independently read. The imported SequentialPrimeSpecification still has its original nonempty/admissible fields; ext compares start/multiplicities under proof irrelevance, not an invented weaker type. axesFrom expands each original prime index once per multiplicity, and all axis-positivity proofs use the exact canonical prime provider.

CoordinateFiber is the whole recursive PUnit/Fin-product family. All cardinality/least-significant mixed-radix/zero/ofNat functions, strict positivity and bound hypotheses, injectivity/range proofs and exact Equiv inverse fields are retained. Empty radices remain the singleton PUnit with cardinality1 and code0; positive hypotheses apply to each member, and ofNat is only a full inverse on values below cardinality.

Cantor triangular formula, bounds and injectivity keep every inequality and Nat arithmetic proof. Finite-list encoding and exact specificationCode injectivity retain the original imported cantorPair,finiteSequenceCode,specificationCode definitions; no alternate pairing or quotient is substituted.

The valid-address record retains occurrence, full original specification and CoordinateFiber specification.axisCardinalities. Its ext theorem retains HEq coordinate. The unit specification/coordinate, occurrence injection, code injectivity, range infinity, noncomputable local Infinite instance, increasing image order-isomorphism, decoded Equiv, canonicalOrder, exact nth identity and inverse Nat.count formula stay together in one coherent module.

Original BitMatrix.Carrier and all nested namespace blocks are copied unchanged to preserve extensions/field notation on imported SequentialPrimeSpecification. Physical paths alone are GRWTSK/actualPMD/variant; namespace metadata records actual BitMatrix.Carrier, with no fabricated GRWTSK alias or wrapper. These isolated uncompiled files cannot be coimported with another copy of the same historical declarations; no public umbrella or canonical provider activation.

All theorem bodies, ext/simp attributes, noncomputable/local instance scope, open scoped BigOperators and inline equivalence/embedding/positive witnesses remain exact.
